title: Working at the Cotton Club on Blue Island
summary: She worked briefly at the Cotton Club on Blue Island and cannot recall which band was there.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Then, when I left there, I went to, to where I worked at the, uh, Cotton Club for a while. Uh, which one? Uh, uh, uh, on Blue Island. Yes. Over there. And, uh...
Do you remember who, uh, had the band there then?
I'm trying to think now, who had the band. Thaymond Hayes? He may have. You get put that...
A band from, from, uh, St. Louis? Or a Chicago band? Or there was also a Chicago band, but I don't remember whose it was. Mm-hmm.
